name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 22 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2026-05-19, at wavelengths from 1.28 to 4.88 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
